A little street sense

One seat. Make it yours.

You don’t have to beat everyone. You have to get on the trotro before it leaves.

W A S D / ↑ ↓ ← →Move through the arena
JStrike the nearest rival. Chain 3 hits for a shove.
K · holdBlock incoming hits. Watch your stamina.
L / SpaceDodge in your movement direction.
RPick up a bag or drink. Drinks restore health.
E · holdBoard at the glowing door once the mate calls.
Esc / PPause and take a breath.

An orange ring means a rival is about to swing. Dodge, then strike while they recover. Keep a little stamina for the door.

 Fight for Trotro

Accra’s rush.
Turned up to eleven.

A fictional scramble for the last seat. Short rounds, readable combat, everyday objects, and the unmistakable energy of trying to get home.

Feel the fight

Combo shoves, bag swings, umbrella jabs, stamina, blocks, and perfectly timed dodges.

Know your city

Six location-inspired arenas, built for the game. The layouts are creative interpretations.

Make the escape

Hold your ground at the blue door, then hold Board. A hit interrupts your boarding.

Character and surface art

Human models and motion from Microsoft Rocketbox. Asphalt by Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven.

Google Maps links open the real locations for exploration. Street View imagery is not included in these arenas.
